SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL PATIENT
Discharge instructions

Keep the dressing clean and dry. Do not soak the treated area.

Follow up with the clinic team within 5 days.
Call for fever, spreading redness, or drainage with a bad smell.

Medication instructions

Take Ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth every 8 hours with food for 3 days.
Apply Mupirocin ointment topically twice a day for 7 days.

Resume usual meals as tolerated.
